messages:
Mike S: Quick sync — product wants a clear launch checklist for geo routing and tenant isolation. Can we define the minimum policy surface for initial launch?
Riya P: +1. Customers keep asking for 'tenant-level residency + fallback to standby region'. Need gating criteria.
Sarah L: Suggest minimum: (1) configurable route precedence, (2) tenant tag residency, (3) regional fallback policy. Also require canary limits.
Devon: Agree. Also we need an infra veto — if cross-region egress cost > $0.50/day per tenant, block auto-fallback.
Riya P: For launch we can accept manual opt-in for fallback, auto-disabled by default. That reduces risk.
Mike S: What about SLA commitments? Product wants to promise <100ms p95 for regional queries. Can't if routing hops across regions without pinned affinity.
Sarah L: Drafted launch criteria: latency SLO must be met in 95% of synthetic tests within selected regions; fallback must be opt-in; canary for first 3 months with limited tenant set.
Devon: Ops note: need observability hooks — per-request route decision logs + cost tags. Without that we can't debug customer regressions.
ops-bot: New ticket created: INF-2981 — add route-decision tracing fields to request logs.
Riya P: Also want a compact policy DSL snippet for teams to configure. Example:
```policy
route {
  match: tenant.id == "T123"
  prefer_region: eu-west-1
  fallback: manual
}
```
Sarah L: That looks good as a starting point. Add `cost_threshold_usd` and `max_latency_ms` fields.
Mike S: Customer asks: Seed customers (ACME, NorthMall) will need data residency agreements — include KMS/HSM + audit logs to qualify for Private.
Devon: Timeline? Product suggests beta in Q3, GA in Q4. Engineering says needs ~6w for core runtime + 4w for console + 2w for canary infra.
Riya P: Prioritization: cut scope for GA: postpone auto-scaling cross-region; only support route policies + manual fallback + tracing.
Sarah L: Action items: (1) define policy schema PR by EOD Friday, (2) infra ticket for route tracing INF-2981, (3) console UX mock for policy editor by next Wed.
Mike S: I'll align with legal on residency checklist. Thanks. :thumbsup:
